Questions roofers ask.

Who makes the calls?

Our trained callers, who introduce themselves as your company.

How fast can we start?

Once we have your zip codes, rules and calendar, we start dialing quickly.

What if an appointment doesn’t meet my rules?

We screen every homeowner against the checks we agreed on before it reaches you.

Do you guarantee closed jobs?

No. We handle calling, qualification and confirmation. Your team closes, and the recording helps your rep walk in prepared.

How much does it cost?

It depends on your market and volume. Send a pilot request and we’ll reply with a proposal.
